payout_quote: New BioLife plasma donors could earn up to $1200 in the first month.* *Offer Terms & Conditions: Donors can earn up to $1,200. Compensation and promotions for eligible, qualified donors vary by location.
steps: Create a BioLife account on the official site and schedule an appointment.
Download your new-donor bonus coupon from your account or the center location page.
Bring the coupon to your first donation and complete the medical screening and health exam.
Continue donating through your first month to accrue toward the up-to-$1,200 total; per-location pages show the bonus for your specific center (examples: $625–$700).
catches: $1,200 is an 'up to' ceiling and BioLife's own terms say compensation 'varies by location' — per-center new-donor bonuses shown on BioLife location pages run $625–$700.
You must be an eligible, qualified donor and pass medical screening; not everyone qualifies.
Reaching the first-month total requires multiple donations across the month; each donation visit takes about 90-150 minutes (first visit longer).
You must create an account and bring the new-donor coupon to your first donation to get the bonus.
biggest_catch: The $1,200 is a national ceiling; BioLife's own per-center pages show lower actual new-donor bonuses ($625–$700 at sampled centers), and compensation 'varies by location' — plus you must pass medical screening.
eligibility: 18+, at least 110 lbs, in good health, valid ID, and must pass BioLife's medical screening and physical exam; the bonus requires the new-donor coupon and an eligible, qualified donor status.
timing: Compensation is paid after each donation via BioLife's payment card; the new-donor total accrues across donations in your first month.

c1.evidence: BioLife Plasma Services is a real operating plasma collection company; official terms page on its own domain.

c2.evidence: Official page states a concrete new-donor compensation figure with location-variance disclosure.

c3.evidence: No fee to donate; donation itself is free and no payment is required to participate.

c4.evidence: Payout amounts and the 'eligible, qualified donors / varies by location' condition are stated on the official page.

s1.note: Eligibility conditions (age, weight, health screening) are stated by the provider.

s2.note: New-donor offer conditions (first month window, eligible/qualified donor) stated on the official page.

s3.note: Compensation is paid after each donation via the center's payment card; new-donor total accrues within the first month.

s4.note: Amounts are framed as 'up to' ceilings that vary by location; no guaranteed fixed total is promised.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: find a center, register, pass screening, donate, get paid per visit.

notes: BioLife Plasma Services (Takeda) verified on its official offer page 2026-09-23. Honest framing: the $1,200 is a ceiling; per-center pages on biolifeplasma.com show $625-$700 new-donor bonuses, cited as evidence that the ceiling is not the norm.
payout_value_note: Official terms state 'up to $1,200' in the first month with no floor; varies by location (sampled centers show $625-$700).
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($1,200 ceiling, first month); time: ~8 donation visits x 90-150 min (first visit runs longer).
